title: Prosthodontists
description: Diagnose, treat, rehabilitate, design, and fit prostheses that maintain oral function, health, and appearance for patients with clinical conditions associated with teeth, oral and maxillofacial tissues, or the jaw.

tasks.text: Restore function and aesthetics to traumatic injury survivors, or to individuals with diseases or congenital disabilities.
Use bonding technology on the surface of the teeth to change tooth shape or to close gaps.
Treat facial pain and jaw joint problems.
Place veneers onto teeth to conceal defects.
Bleach discolored teeth to brighten and whiten them.
Fit prostheses to patients, making any necessary adjustments and modifications.
Replace missing teeth and associated oral structures with permanent fixtures, such as implant-supported prostheses, crowns and bridges, or removable fixtures, such as dentures.
Examine patients to diagnose oral health conditions and diseases.
Measure and take impressions of patients' jaws and teeth to determine the shape and size of dental prostheses, using face bows, dental articulators, recording devices, and other materials.

clusters.label: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Collaborate with general dentists, specialists, and other health professionals to develop solutions to dental and oral health concerns.
Design and fabricate dental prostheses, or supervise dental technicians and laboratory bench workers who construct the devices.

skills.name: Active Listening

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Critical Thinking

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving

skills.name: Reading Comprehension

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Writing
skills.def: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Instructing
skills.def: Teaching others how to do something.

skills.name: Service Orientation

skills.name: Science
skills.def: Using scientific rules and methods to solve problems.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.def: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Learning Strategies

skills.name: Medical software
skills.def: Software to evaluate, plan, or redesign healthcare procedures. May include reporting or visualization features. Examples: Consult-PRO, Henry Schein DentalVision Professional, Henry Schein Dentrix, Henry Schein Easy Dental.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Apple iOS.

skills.name: Graphics or photo imaging software
skills.def: Software to draw or manipulate images. May adjust colors, add text, or apply special effects. Examples: Image management software.
